pilot.purpose: technical validation and within-provider model selection only

model_selection.primary_metric: macro-average objective accuracy across grammar and factual development items
model_selection.tie_rule: if models differ by less than 1 percentage point, select the lower cost per correct response

hypotheses: Persian pivot versus direct Tajik on grammar accuracy
Russian pivot versus direct Tajik on factual accuracy
English pivot versus direct Tajik on factual accuracy
confirmatory_test.familywise_correction: Holm across all model-specific confirmatory comparisons: three contrasts per selected model

translation_diagnostic.purpose: measure meaning change caused by translation separately from task solving

stability.selection: fixed stratified sample by category and register selected before primary collection

human_scoring.second_rater_sample: stratified by model condition category and register
human_scoring.adjudication: retain original ratings and add a third adjudicated value

analysis.interval: item-level paired bootstrap 95 percent CI with 10000 resamples
analysis.exploratory_model: mixed-effects regression with item random intercept if software and convergence permit
analysis.missingness: report every failure; primary complete-pair analysis plus failure-as-incorrect sensitivity analysis
analysis.subgroups: category and register estimates labeled exploratory unless listed as hypotheses

reporting.publication: aggregate dashboard only until dataset and provider-output release rights are confirmed
